notes: NEW - Before / after in Session recorder: record a game, change your settings, record again, then press C on both sessions to see the difference in average FPS, 1% lows and stutters. C copies the result to share
Game profiles: notifications per game - all, only the apps you pick (W opens Windows' list to pick them), or none while you play. Everything comes back when the game closes
System monitor shows your graphics card's temperature and warns when it's slowing itself down from heat (NVIDIA cards). Session recorder now names a too-hot card as a cause of FPS drops
New PC (Apps + storage): saving your app list now saves your MahqLAB settings too - game profiles, screen layouts, theme. Press M on the new PC to put them back
F1 > Setup report: copies a short summary of your PC and setup to paste with a support question
MahqLAB now sets up its own Python by itself, so it keeps working even if the PC's Python changes
